mechanics.claim: Deathbringer Stance's damage applies life steal.
Aatrox heals for the post-mitigation bonus damage dealt by the empowered attack (full amount against champions).
mechanics.quote: '''Aatrox''' {{tip|heals}} for <!--...--> the {{tt|post-mitigation '''bonus''' damage|Damage calculated after modifiers}} dealt

mechanics.claim: If the empowered attack becomes ready during a standard attack's windup, it will not be consumed or trigger the bonus damage on that attack.
mechanics.quote: If ''Deathbringer Stance'' becomes available during a standard attack's windup, it will not be consumed or trigger the '''bonus''' damage.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack cooldown is reduced even if the triggering ability hit was spell-shielded.
mechanics.quote: Even if the ability hit is {{tip|spell shield|spell shielded}} ''Deathbringer Stance's'' cooldown will still be reduced.

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack does not trigger against structures and wards.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will not trigger against {{tip|structures}} and {{tip|wards}}.
